howVerified: Each page was rendered to a PNG with the PDF's own embedded FM font program (pdf.js exposes only the legacy character codes, but the drawn glyphs are the intended Sinhala) and read visually at scale 3-10, then aligned character by character against the legacy string at the same position in the pg*.items.json fixtures. coverage: Questions 1-7, which are all of page 1 — the only question page with a committed item fixture. The plan asks for Q1-16; Q8-16 live on pages 2-3, whose items are not dumped by test/tools/dump-fixtures.mjs, so they are NOT covered here.
whitespaceNote: Stems and options are recorded as PRINTED on the page. Two places on page 1 show a space that does not exist in the PDF's text layer (between the Roman numeral 'I' and the Sinhala that follows it in Q6 option 3 and the Q7 stem, and inside 'ඉන්දියානු සාගරයේ' in Q7 option 3, which is a single text item). Inter-item spacing comes from text-layer item boundaries, not from the transliterator, so the assertion in test/extract/golden.test.ts compares with whitespace removed.
